notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Elite Arcanist by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Roar of the Kha and casting the copy without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Roar of the Kha, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.
